# Shuode

> > Leading manufacturer and supplier of polyurethane foam, silicone sealants, and building adhesives since 2000, serving wholesale and OEM/ODM markets globally.

Shuode specializes in custom polyurethane foam products, silicone sealants, epoxy adhesives, and related application tools for construction, building, and industrial applications. The company offers comprehensive product lines with wholesale pricing, bulk discounts, and OEM/ODM customization services.

## Key Topics

- Polyurethane Foam (PU Foam)
- Silicone Sealant
- Building Adhesive
- Epoxy Adhesive
- Spray Foam
- Liquid Nail Glue
- Foam Gun
- Caulking Gun
- Neutral Silicone Sealant
- Acetoxy Silicone Sealant
- Fire Retardant Foam
- OEM/ODM Manufacturing
- Wholesale Supplier
- Expandable Foam
- Adhesive Sealant
